europe_now.title: MI5 warns UK defense firms of Russian attack threat
europe_now.summary: The UK's domestic intelligence agency has warned that Russian actors are targeting British defense companies. The alert highlights an elevated risk of espionage and sabotage against critical defense infrastructure.

sources.headline: MI5 warns UK defense firms they are target of Russian attacks

europe_now.title: European rights court allows increased returns of asylum seekers to Belarus
europe_now.summary: The European Court of Human Rights has ruled that asylum seekers can be returned to Belarus under certain conditions. The decision follows pressure from nine European governments seeking to tighten migration controls.

sources.headline: Europe’s rights court clears way to return more asylum seekers to Belarus, after pressure from nine governments

top_stories.title: Right-wing revolt threatens EU budget negotiations
top_stories.summary: Right-wing political groups are threatening to obstruct the European Union's budget negotiations. The revolt risks delaying the approval of the EU's financial framework.

sources.headline: Right-wing revolt threatens to bog down EU budget

top_stories.title: Macron considers constitutional fiscal rules
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is considering enshrining fiscal rules in the national constitution. The proposal aims to strengthen budgetary discipline amid public finance debates.

sources.headline: Macron mulls enshrining fiscal rules in French constitution

top_stories.title: EU mining plans in Western Balkans meet local resistance
top_stories.summary: European Union plans to develop mining projects in the Western Balkans face opposition from local communities. Environmental and social concerns are driving the resistance.

sources.headline: EU mining plans in the Western Balkans face local resistance

top_stories.title: Polls show tight race ahead of Spanish general election
top_stories.summary: Recent opinion polls indicate a close contest among major parties before Spain's general election. The surveys suggest no single party is likely to win an outright majority.

sources.headline: What do the latest polls show ahead of Spain’s general election?

top_stories.title: UK seeks public support for EU relations reset
top_stories.summary: British officials are campaigning to rebuild public backing for a reset of relations with the European Union. The effort aims to address post-Brexit tensions through renewed cooperation.
